title: June Discretionary Closure Day
excerpt: The third Friday of June is a discretionary closure day.
body: The third Friday of June is a discretionary closure day for staff training. Families needing emergency care should apply to their campus in advance. Emergency care is available by request — please apply to your campus in advance.

title: Summer English Camp Registration Open
excerpt: Sign up for our summer English camp with native teachers.
body: This July we run a month-long summer English camp with native teachers. Water play, English cooking and outdoor adventures let children experience English naturally. Apply via our KakaoTalk channel by June 20; places are limited per class.

title: Shuttle Bus Route Update
excerpt: Some shuttle routes and times are being adjusted.
body: Reflecting traffic conditions, some shuttle bus routes and pickup times are being adjusted. The updated timetable is shared via newsletter and our KakaoTalk channel. The updated timetable is available in our KakaoTalk channel and the family newsletter.

title: English Library Renovation Complete
excerpt: Our 3,000-book English picture-book library has been renewed.
body: Each campus English library has been refreshed with over 3,000 age-graded English picture books and cozy reading nooks to encourage a love of reading. Each campus library now holds over 3,000 age-graded English picture books.

title: June Meal Menu
excerpt: Here is the June lunch menu.
body: Please find the June lunch menu prepared by our nutritionist. Allergen-containing foods are marked separately on the menu for your reference. Allergen-containing items are marked separately on the menu for your reference.

title: Gwangju Campus Opening
excerpt: Our Honam-region hub, the Gwangju campus, opens.
body: Hanbit opens a new kindergarten campus in Gwangju, bringing English-immersion early education with native-speaking teachers to families in the Honam region. The campus offers the full English-immersion kindergarten programme for ages 3–6.

title: June Parent Information Session
excerpt: An information session for new and current families.
body: On the second Saturday of June, each campus hosts a parent session introducing Hanbit's English-immersion curriculum and daily routine. Reserve a spot in advance. Pre-booking is recommended as seats are limited; sessions run at each campus.

title: KakaoTalk Channel Maintenance Notice
excerpt: Our KakaoTalk channel will be briefly unavailable for maintenance.
body: To keep the service stable, we will perform KakaoTalk channel maintenance. Access may be temporarily limited during the maintenance window. Access may be briefly limited during the maintenance window; thank you for understanding.

title: 2027 Admissions Now Open
excerpt: Applications for the 2027 school year are open across all campuses.
body: We are accepting applications across our kindergarten programme for 2027. Information session dates are on the Events page. Visit the Admissions page for the schedule, required documents and campus quotas.

title: 2026 Native Teaching Team Joins
excerpt: Meet the native teachers joining us this year.
body: Native teachers with rich early-childhood experience have joined the Hanbit family. Co-teaching with homeroom teachers strengthens our English-immersion environment. Co-teaching with homeroom teachers deepens our all-day English environment.

title: English Musical Day 2026
excerpt: Children's English musical performances, all in one place.
body: Our annual English Musical Day returns this year, with children singing and acting on stage in English. Families are welcome to attend and cheer on their children's English performances.

title: Spring Nature Field Trip
excerpt: Children met spring in the woods and fields, in English.
body: We held a spring nature field trip to nearby woods and parks. Children observed flowers and insects and described them in English, learning through all five senses. Children explored nearby woods and parks, describing what they found in English.

title: Regular Health Check-up Notice
excerpt: A spring health check-up for all children.
body: Together with our partner clinic, we hold a spring health check-up for all children. Schedules and preparation details are shared via our family newsletter. Schedules and preparation details are shared via the family newsletter.

title: New Uniform Design Unveiled
excerpt: A new uniform with more comfort and freedom to move.
body: Designed for active little ones, our new uniform uses softer, eco-friendly fabrics. Ordering details will be announced separately. Ordering details and sizing will be announced separately to families.

title: New Phonics English Program
excerpt: A new play-based way to learn English.
body: We have introduced a new phonics programme where kindergarten children learn English through sounds and play. Sounds, songs and play help children build reading confidence step by step.

title: English Reading Awards Ceremony
excerpt: We celebrated children who read steadily all term.
body: Wrapping up the autumn-winter English reading challenge, we held a reading awards ceremony, celebrating children who grew closer to books a little each day. Certificates went to children who kept up their daily English reading all term.
